en.name: Black pepper, ground
en.summary: Ground black pepper keeps 2 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard. Nothing in it can spoil — the figure is a flavour window, and a jar past it is weak rather than unsafe.
en.pantry: 2 years from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and away from the steam of the hob. Grinding a peppercorn opens up an enormous amount of surface, and the volatile oils that carry the aroma start leaving from that moment; the piperine that makes pepper hot lasts longer, which is why an old jar can still bite while smelling of nothing much. Test it rather than the date: tip a little into your palm, warm it, and smell. If there is no lift to it, it will not do anything for a dish.
en.fridge: The fridge is the wrong home for ground pepper. It is humid, and ground pepper cakes as soon as moisture reaches it; it also absorbs the smell of whatever is stored nearby, which is not what you want in something you dust over everything. Keep it in a sealed jar in a cool cupboard instead.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, and freezing ground pepper causes the same condensation problem in a stronger form. The better answer for anyone who wants pepper to taste of pepper is a grinder and a jar of peppercorns — whole spices outlast ground ones for the simple reason that less surface is exposed to the air.
en.thawing: Not applicable — ground pepper is a dry cupboard spice and should not be frozen.
spoilage: No aroma at all when a pinch is warmed in the palm.
A flat, dusty smell rather than a warm, woody one.
Caking into hard lumps, meaning moisture has got in.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that got damp.
tips: Buy peppercorns and grind as you go; the difference is immediate.
Buy small jars of ground pepper rather than a catering tub.
Never season directly over a steaming pan from the jar.
Keep it away from the cooker and out of the light.

faq.q: How long does ground black pepper keep?
faq.a: 2 years from purchase in an airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Is out-of-date ground pepper safe to use?
faq.a: Yes. Dried spices fade rather than spoil, so an old jar is weak rather than dangerous. Only a damp, mouldy jar should be thrown out.

faq.q: Why is freshly ground pepper so much better?
faq.a: The aroma lives in volatile oils that escape as soon as the peppercorn is broken. Grinding to order means none of it has been lost.

zh.name: 黑胡椒粉
zh.summary: 黑胡椒粉自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 2 年。裡面沒有東西會腐敗——這個數字是風味的窗口，過期的一罐是味道弱，不是不安全。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、遠離爐台的蒸氣，自購買日起 2 年。把胡椒粒磨開會打開極大的表面，帶著香氣的揮發性精油從那一刻起就開始離開；讓胡椒辣的胡椒鹼撐得比較久，所以一罐老胡椒可能還是會辣，卻幾乎沒有香氣。請測試而不是看日期：倒一點在手心搓熱，聞一下。如果沒有那股上揚的氣味，它對一道菜也不會有什麼作用。
zh.fridge: 冰箱是黑胡椒粉錯誤的歸宿。冰箱潮濕，而胡椒粉一碰到水氣就結塊；它也會吸收旁邊存放物的味道，而那絕不是你想加在所有菜上的東西。請改用密封罐放在陰涼櫥櫃裡。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，而且冷凍胡椒粉會讓結露問題更嚴重。想讓胡椒吃起來像胡椒，更好的答案是一支研磨罐加一罐整粒胡椒——整粒香料之所以比磨好的耐放，理由很單純：暴露在空氣中的表面比較少。
zh.thawing: 不適用——黑胡椒粉是乾燥的櫥櫃香料，不應冷凍。
spoilage: 在手心搓熱一小撮，完全聞不到香氣。
聞起來平板、像灰塵，而不是溫暖的木質香。
結成硬塊，代表水氣跑進去了。
受潮的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 買整粒現磨；差別是立刻感受得到的。
胡椒粉買小罐，不要買餐飲用的大桶。
不要拿著罐子直接在冒蒸氣的鍋子上方調味。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，自購買日起 2 年。

faq.q: 過期的黑胡椒粉還能用嗎？
faq.a: 可以。乾燥香料是淡掉而不是腐敗，舊罐子只是味道弱。只有受潮發霉的才該丟。

faq.q: 為什麼現磨的胡椒好那麼多？
faq.a: 香氣存在揮發性精油裡，胡椒粒一破開就開始散失。現磨等於一點都還沒跑掉。
